title: The Genomic Patterns of Well-Differentiated Pancreatic Neuroendocrine Tumors (NETs) Identify Sub-Sets for Rational Therapeutic Targeting.
snippet: The natural history of pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (NETs) can span decades of slow progression, but it is unpredictable, with a more aggressive course also being common. title: Comparative Characterisation of Subcutaneous, Intraperitoneal and Intrabursal OVCAR3 Models.

title: Current and Emerging Targeted Therapy in Advanced Gastroesophageal Adenocarcinoma.
snippet: : Advanced gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma (GEA) carries a poor prognosis, with median overall survival of 13-20 months despite standard chemotherapy.
